eligibility.title: Voter Eligibility
rules: Must be 18 years or older as of Jan 1st of the election year.
Must be a resident of the polling area.

registration.title: Registration Process
rules: Submit online via Voters Portal or offline to BLO.

booth.title: Polling Booth Identification
rules: Find your Part Number and Serial Number.

documents.title: Approved Identification Documents
rules: Carry your Voter ID (EPIC) if available.
If EPIC is not available, you can use any of these approved alternatives:

vote.title: The Voting Process
rules: Second Officer inks finger and takes signature.
Press button on EVM and check VVPAT slip.

submit_documents.title: Document Submission & Updates
rules: Submit online via the official NVSP portal (voters.eci.gov.in).
Use the Voter Helpline mobile app for easy uploads.
Visit your local Booth Level Officer (BLO) for offline submission.
Visit the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) office in your area.
Ensure you have accepted proofs for age and address ready.

faqs.q: Can I vote if my name is not in the voter list but I have a Voter ID?
faqs.a: No, your name must be present in the electoral roll to cast a vote.

common_misconceptions.myth: I need my Voter ID card to vote.
common_misconceptions.fact: If your name is in the list, you can use any of the 12 approved IDs like Aadhaar.
